summary: The interface shows layout and bidirectional text issues under RTL orientation, notably detached status indicators in the file tree and bidirectional punctuation artifacts.

issues.title: Detached status indicators in RTL
issues.description: Status dots remain anchored to the far left instead of aligning adjacent to tree nodes on the right.
issues.evidence: Amber, green, and black status dots appear on the far left margin while file labels indent from the right.
issues.suggestion: Mirror status indicator placement to follow row indentation in RTL.

issues.title: Bidirectional punctuation error
issues.description: RTL text rendering places punctuation incorrectly before the deploy identifier.
issues.evidence: The string renders as '.#4217' instead of '#4217'.
issues.suggestion: Wrap technical identifiers in LTR directional isolation tags.
